EU releases €6.6 billion for members arming Ukraine as five killed in Kyiv
items.description: European Union countries have agreed to release €6.6 billion from a fund meant to reimburse member states that have provided arms to Ukraine, EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas said on Friday. At least five people were killed in Russian strikes on Kyiv earlier in the day, according to local authorities.

items.description: Lebanese Prime Minister Nawaf Salam wants a US-brokered ceasefire to be consolidated and for Israel to retreat.

items.title: Ukrainian Soldiers Brave Russian Drones On Trek To Frontline Settlements
items.description: Ukrainian troops trek nearly 20 kilometers to reach Bilozerske in the embattled Donetsk region. In roughly one year, Russian drone and aerial attacks have laid waste to the city that used to house 15,000 inhabitants. Speaking with RFE/RL, one soldier said that "everything is bad" in the Dobropillia area.

items.title: Why Eritrea matters as fighting returns to Tigray
items.description: The US has removed key sanctions on Eritrea as Houthi attacks disrupt Red Sea shipping and fighting escalates in Ethiopia's Tigray region. Analysts say Eritrea's strategic value is growing.

items.title: Netanyahu overflies French airspace again despite ICC arrest warrant
items.description: While the International Criminal Court and its judges face repeated attacks and sanctions, France once again allowed Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to fly over its territory on his way to the UN General Assembly in New York.

items.description: Xi’s first visit to Washington in a decade was a display of pomp and pageantry, with Trump offering his guest a two-month truce on the brewing tariff war.

items.description: The second part of this investigation examines the global reach of Russia’s foreign recruitment campaign, focusing on South Asia, Latin America, Indonesia, and former Soviet states. items.title: Zelenskyy urges stronger pressure on Russia, warns war’s impact is spreading beyond Ukraine
items.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on Wednesday called for intensified pressure on Russia to end its war against Ukraine, arguing that Moscow continues to incur massive losses while prolonging a conflict whose consequences are increasingly being felt far beyond the battlefield.

items.title: At UN, Trump again threatens Iran, but suggests end of war is near
items.description: President Trump used his speech at the United Nations to say he believed the Iran war was coming to a resolution “one way or the other.”
